name: pluck-cms/pluck
description: Pluck CMS 5 - a small, simple, file-first content management system.

suggest.ext-pdo_sqlite: Offers the SQLite storage driver at install time. Without it the flat-file driver is the only option.
suggest.ext-intl: Dates in the reader's own language. Without it dates fall back to the ISO form.
suggest.ext-zip: Reading theme and module archives during installation.
